calls.thesis: Ranked BUY with 5.9% yield; DCF fair value $55 vs $47 market price; undervalued but less so than AT&T; pair with AT&T in a 50/50 split if holding both.
calls.bull_case: Low-single-digit organic growth, op margins up to 22.7%, 5.9% yield beats long bonds.
calls.bear_case: ROIC down from ~12% to 6%, below WACC; saturated market and heavy network capex.
